title: Effect of high-intensity interval training on glycemic control in adults with type 2 diabetes: a randomized controlled trial
items.abstract: We randomized 120 adults with type 2 diabetes to 12 weeks of high-intensity interval training or usual care. The primary outcome was change in HbA1c. High-intensity interval training significantly improved HbA1c and fasting glucose compared with usual care.

title: High-intensity interval training in children and adolescents with obesity: a pilot study
items.abstract: Thirty children and adolescents with obesity completed 8 weeks of high-intensity interval training. We measured insulin sensitivity and body composition before and after the intervention.

title: High-intensity interval training versus moderate continuous training for glycemic control in type 2 diabetes: a randomized controlled trial
items.abstract: Adults with type 2 diabetes were randomized to high-intensity interval training or moderate continuous training for 16 weeks. Glycemic control, measured by HbA1c, improved in both groups, with a larger reduction after high-intensity interval training.

title: Interval training for diabetes care: time to move faster
Entrenamiento interválico de alta intensidad y control glucémico en la diabetes tipo 2: ensayo aleatorizado
items.abstract: Se asignaron al azar 80 adultos con diabetes tipo 2 a entrenamiento interválico de alta intensidad o cuidado habitual durante 12 semanas. El resultado principal fue el cambio en HbA1c.
